notes.posterior: M1 source probabilities for the same decision context
notes.native_route: index of native PMFS route included in the candidate set
notes.realized_source_risk: independently realized/evaluated downstream source risk for every compared route; these outcomes must not be used to construct route_laws
notes.hard_rule: A single historical executed route is not a counterfactual panel and cannot be duplicated or model-imputed as realized outcome evidence.
